topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design affects signal quality, influencing encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Complexity and polarization correlation introduce interference, degrading signal quality. Beamforming techniques and adaptive algorithms can mitigate interference, enhancing signal quality and classification accuracy.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges in traffic classification due to encryption and heterogeneous networks, requiring machine learning solutions.
